opportunities.title: Undergraduate Research Apprentice Program (URAP)
opportunities.organization: UC Berkeley Office of Undergraduate Research & Scholarships
opportunities.description: Work on a faculty research project for academic credit. Browse hundreds of projects across engineering and the sciences and apply directly to the ones that interest you.
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduates in any major; no prior research experience needed.

opportunities.title: Big Ideas Contest
opportunities.description: Pitch an idea for social impact and compete for seed funding, with mentorship and workshops along the way. Teams may include students from any discipline.
opportunities.eligibility: Teams led by a current UC Berkeley student.

opportunities.title: Summer 2027 engineering internships
opportunities.description: Hundreds of employers post summer internships for Berkeley engineers on Handshake. Filter by major and graduation year, and book a resume review with Career Engagement before applying.

opportunities.title: Engineers' Week 2027
opportunities.description: A week of events celebrating engineering at Berkeley, with sponsor booths, club showcases, Engineers Ball, and Engineering 4 Kids Day.
